claims: Mortgage loan officers are licensed professionals working for banks or lenders.
Mortgage loan officers guide borrowers through the home loan process.
Mortgage loan officers analyze financial data.
Mortgage loan officers secure financing.
Mortgage loan officers require NMLS licensing.
The NMLS licensing required for mortgage loan officers typically includes 20+ hours of pre-licensing education.
The NMLS licensing required for mortgage loan officers typically includes a background check.
The average annual salary for mortgage loan officers is approximately $63,380.
Mortgage loan officers act as the main point of contact for homebuyers.
Mortgage loan officers help homebuyers determine qualification.
Mortgage loan officers help homebuyers choose loan types.
Mortgage loan officers manage the application process.
All mortgage loan officers must be registered with the Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System (NMLS).
All mortgage loan officers must pass a licensing exam.
Mortgage loan officers' compensation includes commissions based on loan volume.

Mortgage loan officers usually work for one specific bank or lender.
Loan originator and loan officer are sometimes used interchangeably.

A loan officer specifically refers to the individual facilitating the process.
